title: Adapting the Electrospinning Process to Provide Three Unique Environments for a Tri-layered In Vitro Model of the Airway Wall
protocol: Prepare a solution of PET in a 1:1 dichloromethane (DCMro) – trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) solution for electrospinning.
Stir the PET solution overnight at room temperature for dissolution.
Transfer the dissolved PET solution into a syringe and attach a 23-G needle for nanofiber scaffolds or an 18-G needle for microfiber and aligned scaffolds to the syringe.
Place the syringe into a motorised syringe pump with the needle tip rotated to the bottom.
Position the mandrel 15 cm away from the tip of the needle, ensuring it points at the center of the drum.
Attach electricity supply to the needle tip using crocodile clips and ground the mandrel via banana socket to earth.
Switch on the power supply to the mandrel for nanofiber and microfiber scaffolds, setting speed to 60 rpm (equivalent to approximately 13.2 m·min-1).
Set speed to 2,000 rpm (equivalent to approximately 440 m·min-1) for aligned scaffolds.
Set the syringe pump to a flow rate of 0.5 ml·hr-1 for nanofiber random and aligned scaffolds or 2.0 ml·hr-1 for microfiber scaffolds.
Run the pump until solution is extruded from the needle tip to remove air.
Stop the pump after removing air.
Set the total volume of solution to be expelled to 2 ml on the syringe pump.
Start the pump with the set volume.
Set voltage supply to 14 kV and switch on power supply.
Electrospin until 2 ml of solution has been electrospun (4 hr for nanofiber and aligned scaffolds, 1 hr for microfiber scaffolds).
Cut the scaffold along the width of the mandrel with a blade.
Peel off the rectangular sheet from the mandrel carefully.
Store the scaffold in aluminum foil to reduce electrostatic charge.
Punch out discs of biphasic or aligned scaffolds using a 0.8 mm diameter biopsy pen.
Stick the punched-out discs to gasket using non-toxic aquarium glue.
Sterilize scaffolds using ultraviolet irradiation for 30 min on each side of the scaffolds.
Soak scaffolds in a 20% vol/vol antibiotic/antimycotic solution overnight at 4 °C.
Wash scaffolds with PBS three times.
Store scaffolds in TCP well plates in PBS at 4°C until use.
Culture CALU3 epithelial cells in DMEM-F12 media supplemented with 10% fetal calf serum, 2 nM L-glutamine solution, and 1% antibiotic/antimycotic solution.
Culture MRC5 fibroblast and ASM cells in DMEM media supplemented with 10% fetal calf serum, 2 nM L-glutamine solution, and 1% antibiotic/antimycotic solution.
Culture epithelial-fibroblast-ASM cell co-cultures in a 70:30 DMEM-F12:DMEM media mixture.
Soak the scaffolds in DMEM-supplemented media in a tissue culture plate and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour before seeding cells.
Remove the DMEM-supplemented media from the scaffolds.
Place the microfiber phase of the scaffold apically.
Seed 1.5 x 10^4 MRC5 fibroblast cells in 30 μl of DMEM-supplemented media onto the scaffold.
Agitate the tissue culture plate on an orbital shaker for 2 hours.
Leave the seeded scaffolds in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2 in air overnight.
Turn the scaffold over so the nanofiber phase faces apically.
Seed 3.0 x10^4 CALU3 epithelial cells in 30 μl of DMEM–F12-supplemented media onto the nanofiber phase of the scaffold.
Incubate for 2 hr at 37 °C, 5% CO2 in air.
Submerge the scaffold in 70:30 DMEM-F12:DMEM-supplemented media overnight before transferring to the bioreactor.
Soak scaffolds in DMEM-supplemented media in a tissue culture plate.
Incubate for 1 hr at 37 °C.
Seed 2.5 x10^4 cells in 30 μl of DMEM-supplemented media onto the scaffold.
Incubate for 2 hr (37 °C, 5% CO2 in air).
Submerge scaffold in DMEM-supplemented media and return to incubator overnight before setting up a tri-culture in the bioreactor.
Place the biphasic scaffold gasket into the groove within one chamber with the epithelial phase facing up into the chamber.
Place the aligned scaffold underneath the biphasic scaffold.
Lock the two chambers of the bioreactor together.
Assemble two perfusion flow circuits connected to medium reservoirs.
Connect one circuit to an apical reservoir containing DMEM-F12-supplemented media.
Connect another circuit to a basal reservoir containing DMEM-F12/DMEM-supplemented media.
Pump media around both circuits at 0.1 ml/min using a peristaltic pump.
Recycle approximately 40 ml of medium through each circuit.
House the entire system within an incubator set at 37 °C and 5% CO2 in air.
After one week, remove the media from the apical chamber.
Culture epithelial cells at the ALI for a further week before analysis.
